profile.headline: Software Engineer at Kohl's | Full Stack Web Development expertise
profile.summary: As a full-stack developer experienced with React.js, Node.js, Next.js, Redux, TypeScript, GraphQL, and Playwright, I’m driven to create seamless applications—and to ensure they perform flawlessly through comprehensive testing.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed an API using Express.js to validate data used in Machine Learning, enhancing accuracy and efficiency of data processing
* Mentored interns, teaching programming and giving constructive feedback to support their professional growth
* Utilized React.js and Next.js to construct in-house applications, resulting in streamlined workflows and improved user experience
* Worked with Micro Frontends using Astro.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Worked on several enterprise-level projects as a full-stack developer including an inventory management and POS system for an international pizza chain   
* Facilitated retrospectives to assist in the success of  development teams
* Predominantly used ReactJS, Redux, and Express
* Experience being the ReactJS SME

positions.title: Test Engineer
positions.description:
* Wrote unit tests using Jest and Mocha
* Used Agile best practices
* Wrote automated test cases in Selenium

honors.title: Values in Action Award (Registry and Lists Team)
honors.description: An award that recognizes the contributions that this brand new team has had on the company culture.
